T:P1.3.text: At Accendra Health (formerly known as Owens & Minor, Inc.), care is a promise. A promise of peace of mind, a promise of confidence, and a commitment to connecting patients, providers, and insurers so healthcare works better for everyone.

T:P1.4.text: Backed by the industry-leading expertise of our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health provides patients with critical products, services, and support to manage their health, helping to improve outcomes for millions of people each year.

T:P1.5.text: Reimagining the Future of Home-Based Care

T:P1.6.text: Accendra Health is reimagining the future of home-based care with one of the broadest portfolios of essentials for diabetes, sleep health, wound care, respiratory care, urology, and ostomy.

T:P1.7.text: Great care starts with our team. Here’s how we take care of you.

T:P1.8.text: Medical, dental, and vision care coverage

T:P1.9.text: Mental, physical, and financial well-being programs

T:P1.10.text: Stay Connected for the Latest News

T:P1.11.text: Visit our Newsroom for the latest news and updates from Accendra Health.

T:P2.2.text: Healthcare is complicated. Accendra Health makes it a little easier by Bringing Care To Life ™.

T:P2.3.text: At Accendra Health (formerly known as Owens & Minor, Inc.), care is a promise. A promise that gives healthcare professionals peace of mind that their patients can get the care they need. A promise offering confidence to people that they can manage their health and live life on their own terms. A commitment to connecting patients, providers, and insurers so healthcare works better for everyone.

T:P2.4.text: With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials. We overcome obstacles. We educate and provide answers. We make it possible for patients and families to access healthcare when and where they need it, helping to improve outcomes for millions of people each year who receive care at home.

T:P2.5.text: Healthcare is complicated, but Accendra Health is here to help make it a little easier. We focus on the details of bringing care into the home, empowering patients with critical products, services, and support so they can focus on the moments that matter most.

T:P2.6.text: At Accendra Health, our Purpose drives us. Bringing Care To Life ™ means meeting people where they are and delivering care that fits their lives beyond traditional settings.

T:P2.7.text: Our Mission is to provide innovative solutions that ensure patients get the care they need in the comfort of their homes.

T:P2.8.text: Our Vision is to be a leading partner in care for medical equipment, supplies, and solutions in the home for individuals, families, and caregivers.

T:P3.2.text: Two Trusted Names. One Bright Future.

C:P1.1.text: The Ensign Group, Inc. – Skilled Nursing, Rehabilitation Therapy, Healthcare – San Juan Capistrano, CA

C:P1.2.text: Ensign’s independent operating affiliates provide personalized post-acute and long-term care services guided by local leadership and delivered by clinicians committed to helping residents heal, regain independence, and thrive.

C:P1.3.text: Commitment to quality Find care near you

C:P1.4.text: At the heart of our organization are hundreds of dedicated affiliates who enrich the lives of thousands of residents each year through exceptional care and genuine human connection.

C:P1.5.text: Through Moments of Truth, we will dignify post-acute care in the eyes of the world.

C:P1.6.text: Ensign Affiliates Provide Care That Counts

C:P1.8.text: Ensign affiliates provide skilled nursing, rehabilitation, therapy, and assisted living services through a unique ONE CLINICAL approach.

C:P1.9.text: This collaborative model brings an interdisciplinary team together at each location to deliver individualized, resident-centered care. By combining clinical excellence, exceptional service, and data-driven decision-making, the ONE CLINICAL teams help residents achieve better outcomes and live life to the fullest.

C:P1.10.text: Of Ensign-affiliated skilled nursing operations earned a CMS Quality Measure rating of 4 or 5 stars.*

C:P1.11.text: Better rehospitalization rates than the national average. Clinical teams work proactively to identify changes in condition early, intervene quickly, and help residents heal safely in place whenever possible.**

C:P2.1.text: Care Services – The Ensign Group, Inc.

C:P2.2.text: Ensign affiliates provide skilled nursing, rehabilitation, therapy, and assisted living services that leverage a ONE CLINICAL collaborative model of care focused on enhancing the lives of those they serve.

C:P2.4.text: At Ensign-affiliated locations, exceptional care begins with collaboration. Through a ONE CLINICAL approach, nurses, therapists, physicians, and interdisciplinary care teams work together to provide coordinated, personalized care that supports each resident’s unique needs. This collaborative model helps each resident benefit from a seamless, individualized care experience designed to maximize that individual resident’s health and wellness.

C:P2.5.text: Care Designed Around the Whole Person

C:P2.6.text: Rather than treating individual conditions in isolation, Ensign-affiliated teams take a comprehensive view of residents’ health. By combining clinical expertise, compassionate caregiving, and evidence-based practices, residents obtain the support they need to recover from illness, regain function, maintain independence, and achieve their highest possible quality of life.

C:P2.7.text: Driven by Data. Focused on Outcomes.

C:P2.8.text: The ONE CLINICAL approach is guided by clinical data and continuous improvement principles. Care teams monitor key quality measures and resident outcomes to identify risks early, evaluate progress, and develop targeted interventions that support better health and recovery. This commitment to measurement and accountability helps drive stronger outcomes while supporting overall quality of care and promoting regulatory excellence.

C:P3.2.text: Our affiliated locations are led by local teams who independently make decisions and create exceptional experiences for those they serve.
